raw_text: ALERT: Traffic signals across Pune malfunctioning since early morning. Multiple intersections showing green in all directions simultaneously. Several accidents reported. Pune police asking citizens to treat all signals as four-way stops. Suspected cyber attack on smart city infrastructure. #PuneTraffic #SmartCity #CyberAttack
